findings: Huisvestingsverordening Bodegraven-Reeuwijk 2023 remains current in 2026.
The regulation makes specified changes to the housing stock permit-dependent, including withdrawal, merger, conversion, dwelling formation and splitting into apartment rights.

Opkoopbescherming applies municipality-wide to qualifying dwellings with a WOZ value up to 70% of the NHG cost limit and lasts four years after registration of the deed, subject to statutory/regulatory conditions and exceptions.
Tourist-rental articles in this regulation are reserved and therefore cannot be used as a positive tourist-rental permit regime.
Current 2026 municipal legislation was found, but no sufficiently specific current dedicated Huisvestingsverordening/opkoopbescherming/room-rental framework was established in this pass.
